#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Print the three most frequent words from stdin.
# Lower-cases input, splits on non-letter characters, outputs
# "<word> <count>" lines sorted by frequency desc, ties alphabetically.
tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' |
  grep -o '[a-z]\+' |
  sort |
  uniq -c |
  sort -rn -k1,1 -k2,2 |
  head -3 |
  awk '{print $2, $1}'
